name: 美國 ISM 製造業 PMI
text: The ISM Manufacturing PMI edged down to 54.5 in September 2026 from 54.6 in August, compared to forecasts of 55. Still, the reading continued to point to robust growth in the manufacturing sector, with new orders (55.3 vs 53.7) and employment (52.7 vs 51.2) rising at a faster pace while production slowed slightly (56.7 vs 58.3).

name: 美國 ISM 服務業 PMI
text: The ISM Services PMI rose to 55.4 in August 2026 from 54.1 in July, beating forecasts of 54.3. The reading pointed to the strongest gain in the services sector in six months, with business activity (61.7 vs 59.1), new orders (60.9 vs 57.2), inventories (56.7 vs 51.4) all rising at a faster pace.

name: 台灣製造業 PMI
text: The S&P Global Taiwan Manufacturing PMI rose to 56.7 in September 2026 from 54.7 in August, marking its strongest reading since August 2021. Output and new orders expanded at their fastest rates in over five years, supported by stronger domestic and overseas demand, particularly for AI-related products.

name: CPI 年增率
text: The annual inflation rate in the US steadied at 3.4% in August 2026, the same as in July and in line with forecasts. Gasoline prices rose 27.4% yoy, slightly more than 24.6% in July and fuel oil prices increased 52%, compared with 39.1% previously.

name: CPI 月增率
text: US consumer prices rose 0.4% month-on-month in August 2026, accelerating from 0.1% in July and in line with expectations. It was the largest monthly increase in three months, driven primarily by a 3.9% surge in gasoline prices as crude prices rallied amid escalating US-Iran tensions.

name: 核心 CPI 年增率
text: The core inflation rate in the US, which excludes exogenous food and fuel costs, eased to 2.4% in August of 2026 from 2.5% the previous month, aligned with market expectations. It was the lowest since March 2021, showing some normalization since surging in the post-Covid economy.

name: 核心 CPI 月增率
text: Core consumer prices in the United States, which exclude food and energy, went up by 0.3% over a month in August 2026, the most since April, following a 0.2% increase in July and above market forecasts of a 0.2% rise. Higher prices for communication services, airline fares, education, used cars and trucks, and lodging away from home were partly offset by declines in medical care and motor vehicle insurance costs.

name: PPI 年增率
text: US producer prices rose 5.4% year-on-year in August 2026, accelerating from a 4.8% increase in July and slightly exceeding market expectations of a 5.3% rise. Core PPI, which excludes food and energy, increased 4.6% year-on-year.

name: PPI 月增率
text: Producer prices in the US increased 0.4% mom in August 2026, following an upwardly revised 0.1% rise in July and in line with expectations. It is the biggest increase in three months, led by a 1.1% jump in prices of goods after declines in each of the previous two months, with diesel fuel jumping 24.1%.

name: 核心 PPI 年增率
text: Core producer price inflation in the United States, which exclude food and energy goods, inched up to 4.6% in August 2026 from an upwardly revised 4.3% in July, matching market estimates. On a monthly basis, core PPI rose 0.2% in August, slowing from the upwardly revised 0.3% increase in the previous month and below the expected 0.3% advance.

name: PCE 年增率
text: US PCE inflation held at 3.4% year-on-year in August 2026, unchanged from a downwardly revised July reading and below market expectations of 3.7%. Core PCE inflation, which excludes food and energy, also held steady at 3.0%.

name: 核心 PCE 年增率
text: The US core PCE price index, the Federal Reserve's preferred measure of underlying inflation, increased 3% year-on-year in August 2026, coming in below the 3.3% rise expected by markets. The latest reading followed a downward revision to July's figure, with the annual increase now estimated at 3%, compared with the previously reported 3.3%.

name: 核心 PCE 月增率
text: The US core PCE price index, the Federal Reserve's preferred measure of underlying inflation, increased 0.2% month-on-month in August 2026, coming in below the 0.3% rise expected by markets. The latest reading followed a downward revision to July's figure, with the monthly increase now estimated at 0.1%, compared with the previously reported 0.2%.

name: 個人消費支出月增率
text: US personal consumption expenditures increased by $190.8 billion, or 0.9%, in August 2026, the most since March, exceeding expectations for a 0.8% rise and accelerating from a downwardly revised 0.1% gain in July. Goods spending rose $114.1 billion, driven by higher spending on nondurable goods, including other nondurable goods (up $24.7 billion), gasoline and other energy goods (up $20.9 billion), and food and beverages (up $11.6 billion), while durable goods spending increased $48 billion.

name: 失業率
text: The US unemployment rate remained unchanged at 4.1% in August 2026, in line with market expectations. The number of unemployed increased by 115,000 to 7.03 million, while total employment surged by 569,000 to 162.75 million.

name: 非農就業人數
text: The US economy is expected to have added 90K jobs in September 2026, following a stronger-than-expected 162K gain in August. The private sector is forecast to have accounted for 85K of those gains.

name: 聯準會利率決策
text: The Fed unanimously raised the target range for the federal funds rate by 25bps to 3.75%-4.00% in September 2026 as expected, marking the first rate hike since 2023. Policymakers noted that inflation remains elevated, and the move aims to support a more timely return to the 2% target.
